label: Executive Summary — IT transformation programme
storyContext:
Story 1 (score=9200bps): [Ref ref-001]
Requirement: The vendor must demonstrate delivery of large-scale IT transformation programmes across multiple European countries.
Match rationale: Amaris delivered a 14-country ERP harmonisation for a Tier-1 automotive group, 320 consultants over 22 months, on-time and within budget.

Story 2 (score=8750bps): [Ref ref-002]
Requirement: The vendor must provide dedicated programme governance and PMO capability.
Match rationale: Amaris established a PMO office for a French telecoms operator, reducing time-to-decision by 40% through standardised governance rituals.
draft:
Amaris is uniquely positioned to deliver this IT transformation programme, drawing on a proven track record across European markets.

Our recent 14-country ERP harmonisation engagement for a Tier-1 automotive group — delivered by 320 consultants over 22 months — demonstrates our capacity to scale rapidly while maintaining delivery discipline. The programme concluded on time and within budget, underscoring our commitment to rigorous project controls.

Our dedicated PMO capability is a strategic differentiator. For a leading French telecoms operator, we established a PMO that reduced time-to-decision by 40%, enabling the client to accelerate strategic initiatives without sacrificing governance integrity.

We are confident that Amaris brings the depth, breadth, and operational maturity required to deliver transformational outcomes for your organisation.
